title: Recursive three-block majority tree
statement: For each depth $d$ and each seed in the recursively defined seed space, construct a decision tree on $3^d$ sign coordinates. At depth zero it queries the sole coordinate; at each greater depth it places three recursively constructed trees in the three disjoint blocks and combines them in an order selected by the seed's block index.
